title: Marketing-to-sales handover: qualify, assign, accept, learn
seoTitle: Marketing-to-Sales Handover: A Practical Checklist | Faraz Ansari
description: A practical B2B lead handover framework for qualification, assignment, sales acceptance and feedback, with HubSpot and ICO guidance.
deck: A lead is not handed over by changing a CRM field. Define shared qualification, ownership, acceptance, feedback and contact rules first.
heroAlt: Original four-stage marketing-to-sales handover diagram: qualify for fit and intent, assign an owner, confirm acceptance, then record the outcome and return path
heroCaption: Qualify, assign, accept and learn: four separate handover decisions.
